Name: Greenhouse Sprinklers Compat
Author: SwEikil
Description:
[size=4]Greenhouse Sprinklers Compat makes Greenhouse Sprinklers work correctly with Better Building Upgrades.[/size]

Normally, Greenhouse Sprinklers expects the vanilla Greenhouse building type. This causes problems once the greenhouse is upgraded by Better Building Upgrades.

This mod fixes that by making Greenhouse Sprinklers target the greenhouse you actually have, while keeping the current greenhouse upgrade tier intact.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Greenhouse Sprinklers.[/*]
[*]Install Better Building Upgrades.[/*]
[*]Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Supports the normal, Big and Deluxe Greenhouse.[/*]
[*]Supports all 3 Greenhouse Sprinklers upgrade levels.[/*]
[*]Keeps the current greenhouse tier after installing a Greenhouse Sprinklers upgrade.[/*]
[*]Updates Greenhouse Sprinklers upgrades when the greenhouse is upgraded later.[/*]
[*]No config required.[/*]
[*]No save editing required.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7456]Greenhouse Sprinklers[/url][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]
Multiplayer has not been tested. It should work in theory, but compatibility isn't guaranteed.
If you try it in multiplayer, feedback and bug reports are welcome.

[b][size=4]Other greenhouse mods[/size][/b]
This mod was made for and tested with Better Building Upgrades.
Since it detects the current greenhouse building type dynamically, it may also work with other mods that upgrade or replace the greenhouse in a similar way, but this has not been tested. Feedback is welcome.

[size=4][b]Tested in singleplayer with:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2[/*]
[*]Greenhouse Sprinklers 3.2.3[/*]
[*]Better Building Upgrades 1.0.20[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thanks to the authors of Greenhouse Sprinklers and Better Building Upgrades for creating the original mods this compatibility patch builds on.
